business: Cart & Grounds, a mobile specialty coffee cart for office parks
target: Office workers at business parks who buy coffee two or more times on a work day

behaviours.name: daily regular
behaviours.how: buys coffee most mornings, has a usual order, notices when the line is long

behaviours.name: deal hunter
behaviours.how: compares prices, screenshots loyalty offers, will walk two blocks to save a dollar

behaviours.name: quality first
behaviours.how: reads about beans and gear, will pay more for a better cup, sceptical of carts

behaviours.name: meeting runner
behaviours.how: buys 3 to 6 drinks at once for the team, cares about speed and carrying trays

objections: A cart feels less hygienic than a shop
The line will be long when I have ten minutes
It might not be there tomorrow, so I should not depend on it
It is probably cheaper to make it in the office kitchen
I do not carry cash and the card reader might be flaky
There is already a chain coffee shop in the building lobby
habits: walks past the same spot twice a day on the commute
orders a large latte, no sugar, before checking email
usually buys one more coffee after lunch, out of habit
keeps a mental budget for work-day coffee
